title: Pakistan sets September 5 deadline for crypto firms to register
dek: Pakistan has mandated that crypto firms serving local users since March 2026 must apply for regulatory clearance by September 5, 2026, and subsequently incorporate domestically to continue operations.
author: Crypto Cronkite
key_fact: Crypto platforms must register by September 5 or lose access to Pakistani users; domestic incorporation is required after approval.
bottom_line: September 5 marks a hard regulatory cutoff for crypto platforms in Pakistan. Watch for announcements from major global exchanges confirming their registration applications and any regulatory guidance on the incorporation process and timeline.
body: Pakistan has imposed a September 5, 2026 deadline for crypto firms serving local users to apply for regulatory clearance, according to Decrypt's reporting. The requirement applies to any platform that has offered services to Pakistani users since March 2026.

Following approval of the clearance application, firms must incorporate domestically within Pakistan to maintain access to the market. Decrypt's reporting does not specify the approval timeline, compliance criteria, penalties for missed registration, or the regulatory authority enforcing the requirement.

The deadline creates a binary outcome: platforms either commit to the registration and incorporation process or exit the Pakistani market. Decrypt does not report whether any major global exchanges have already applied or signaled intent to comply with the requirements.
